reading: A print-studio landing page: cream dot-grid background, a bare-text nav, a huge triple-overprinted "27" headline, a printer's registration-mark icon, a bordered serif pull-quote, a tilted "OPEN STUDIO SAT" block, and a footer strip of 8 colour swatches with 3 small print-run caption labels, all content taken verbatim from the typed notes.
